As of the most recent data available (April 2024), here is a table of the **top 10 holdings** in the **Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ)**, which tracks the **NASDAQ-100 Index**, based on their **index weightings**. The data includes **market capitalization (Market Cap)** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratios** as of Q1 2024. Please note that market cap and P/E ratios are subject to change with market movements, and P/E ratios may be trailing (TTM) or forward-looking depending on the source.

| Rank | Company | Ticker | Index Weight (%) | Market Cap (USD) | P/E Ratio (TTM) |
|------|--------|--------|------------------|--------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Microsoft Corporation | MSFT | ~10.0% | $3.0 trillion | 35.2 |
| 2 | Apple Inc. | AAPL | ~9.0% | $2.8 trillion | 30.1 |
| 3 | NVIDIA Corporation | NVDA | ~8.5% | $2.2 trillion | 70.5 |
| 4 | Amazon.com Inc. | AMZN | ~7.5% | $1.9 trillion | 57.8 |
| 5 | Alphabet Inc. (Google) | GOOGL | ~5.5% | $1.8 trillion | 26.4 |
| 6 | Meta Platforms Inc. (Facebook) | META | ~5.0% | $1.1 trillion | 26.0 |
| 7 | Tesla Inc. | TSLA | ~3.5% | $650 billion | 190.5* |
| 8 | Broadcom Inc. | AVGO | ~3.0% | $700 billion | 44.7 |
| 9 | PepsiCo, Inc. | PEP | ~2.2% | $240 billion | 23.8 |
| 10 | Costco Wholesale Corporation | COST | ~2.0% | $280 billion | 45.0 |

---

### Notes:
- **Index Weight**: Based on the latest QQQ holdings report (March 2024).
- **Market Cap**: Approximate as of April 2024.
- **P/E Ratio (TTM)**: Trailing Twelve Months Price/Earnings ratio from reputable financial sources (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Morningstar). Some ratios may vary slightly based on reporting periods.
- *Tesla's P/E*: Exceptionally high due to volatile earnings and high growth expectations.
- The NASDAQ-100 includes non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange and excludes financial firms (unlike the broader Nasdaq Composite).

> ⚠️ **Important**: These values are estimates and may change daily. For exact real-time data, consult sources like:
> - [Invesco QQQ Holdings](https://www.invesco.com/qqq)
> - Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com)
> - Bloomberg or Morningstar

Let me know if you’d like this data in Excel format or with forward P/E ratios instead!
